desc: The TD32-70 Multispectral Rifle Scope revolutionizes hunting with four observation channels, thermal image and night vision/day time image. You can use each image channels seperately or combine a thermal main image with a night vision/daytime PIP or switch the thermal image into PIP as you need. By doing this, you can enjoy the benefits of thermal identification and night vision target recognition.The scope features PIP mode enables the simultaneous display of thermal imaging and night vision on the same screen, allowing for enhanced observation, identification and precise shooting; ballistic calculation function, hunters can quickly and accurately shoot the target; convenient knob control for instant switching the position between thermal imaging and night vision display on the same screen; Reticle color red/white/yellow/green; Laser Range Finder with an impressive range of 1200yds delivers real-time and accurate distance measurements; thermal imaging detector with a resolution of 384-288, 12m pixel pitch and NETD25mK, combined with a high-performance CMOS sensor and multi-channel display, the TD32-70 provides a versatile hunting experience in various scenarios. Includes two PARD 30mm standard mounts.
